title: Filters: greyscale, blur and brightness
summary: filter changes how an element is rendered; hover a tile to remove its filter.
explanation: filter takes the element as painted, children included, and applies effects to it: grayscale() drains the colour, blur() softens, brightness() darkens or lightens. Several can be chained with spaces.
Each tile here starts filtered and drops its filter on :hover, a common pattern for galleries and logos. Hover over them in the preview.
The last tile uses drop-shadow(), which follows the visible shape. On a rounded tile it looks like box-shadow; on a transparent image it would hug the outline.
tryThis: Hover each tile in the preview.
Chain two filters on .grey: grayscale(1) brightness(1.2).
Change blur(3px) to blur(10px): even the label becomes unreadable, because the filter applies to the children too.
